question: What is the frequency of an object if we know that it oscillates 100 times in 5 seconds?
solution:
The correct answer is __**20 Hz**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Frequency** is defined as the number of oscillations per unit time.
 
• The formula to calculate the frequency (f) is **f = N / T**, where N is the number of oscillations and T is the time in seconds.
